services.title: End-to-end solutions for your digital transformation

items.title: Web & Mobile Development
items.description: Blazing-fast web platforms and native/cross-platform mobile apps designed for frictionless user experiences. Next.js, Flutter, React Native — we choose the right technology for your project.

items.title: Artificial Intelligence & ML
items.description: Intelligent automation, predictive models, and conversational agents trained on your enterprise data. We deploy LLMs, vision systems, and recommendation engines tailored to your real business needs.

items.title: Cloud & DevOps
items.description: Resilient cloud architectures on AWS, Azure, or GCP with containerization, Kubernetes orchestration, and high-velocity CI/CD pipelines. Zero downtime. Infrastructure as Code. Guaranteed high availability.

items.title: UI/UX & Product Design
items.description: Interfaces that convert and engage. We practice user research, rapid prototyping, and modular design systems to create memorable digital experiences.

items.title: Cybersecurity & Audits
items.description: Complete protection of your digital assets: penetration testing, secure code review, GDPR compliance, and security policy implementation to protect your infrastructure and data.

items.title: Custom Software & SaaS
items.description: Modular ERPs, enterprise applications, and scalable multi-tenant SaaS platforms. We architect systems capable of handling millions of requests without breaking a sweat.

items.title: Codorah Academy — Training
items.description: Intensive bootcamps in web development, practical AI, cybersecurity, and computer basics. Training led by practicing engineers, focused on real projects, and rewarded with a recognized certificate.
